goal: Prove the Khitmee backend sustains the 1-hour seasonal workload (100 and 125 vouchers/min plus managers) on a 2 vCPU / 2 GiB capped guest with exact stock-ERPNext parity; stock ERPNext/Frappe remains the untouched oracle. Integrates PR17 changes.
grill_summary: Integrates PR17 (merged into branch; PR17 need not merge). Base main. Oracle: stock ERPNext/Frappe never edited; mismatches reported with root cause. Acceptance: 1h seasonal (100/125 vouchers/min + managers) on 2vCPU/2GiB capped guest, p95 budgets, no OOM, no duplicate postings, exact parity. Architecture per ADR 0002 (GPT-6.2 Astra): keep transactional getseries, shrink post-naming work. Rust only for measured CPU-bound pure batch steps. Workers: SWE-2.1 standard / GPT-6.2 Sol.
